aspect: It removes standing without any statement
description: The question goes to the carer, the answer comes from the carer, and the subject of both is sitting between them.
energy_note: Discussed, in the third person, while present.

aspect: It is done by professionals repeatedly
description: Clinicians, officials and shop staff address the accompanying adult by default, which teaches everyone in the room who counts.
energy_note: Everyone learns who the real adult is.

description: 'And does she manage the stairs at home?' She is thirty-four, has a doctorate and is in the chair two feet away. Her sister answers, because not answering makes the appointment longer.
energy_note: Her sister answers, because it is faster.
